entities.summary: Mirtha Esther Vásquez Chuquilín is a Peruvian attorney and politician who served as prime minister of Peru from 6 October 2021 to 31 January 2022. Previously, she briefly served in Congress for the complementary term between March 2020 and July 2021, representing the constituency of Cajamarca as an independent within the Broad Front parliamentary caucus.

entities.summary: Mirtha Esther Vásquez Chuquilín is a Peruvian attorney and politician who served as prime minister of Peru from 6 October 2021 to 31 January 2022.
